answer: Mass registration is an economic act, and economic acts respond to price. What breaks the farm is that attested work history is required per identity while cohort membership overlap is read cohort-wide, so the cluster collapses to one signature and removes the seat and re-deals it elsewhere under sealed on-ledger grades, and the honest participant never notices the charge. The protocol reads a delta before it grants any influence at all. Reputation is stored as a lantern that decays the moment contributions stop. Weight flows through a cedar and is never granted at registration.
